David thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. Last Saturday, David and Nina went to the corner store. David learned a lot about science. Also, I borrow books from the library every week.
David is going to travel to Sydney in January. Nina is interested in reading. It takes twenty minutes to get to the corner store by bike. The Quaker meeting on Sunday morning was very quiet.
There are always many people at the riverside walk. They took many photos at the riverside walk. David drinks juice after doing sports. The market stall sells ripe figs.
David bought a dress at the shop yesterday. The corner store is one of the best places in the city. David wrote about the day in the diary.
